data.name: Sharunikaal
data.gender_notes: Sharunikaal is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharunikaal is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharu' which means 'Prosperity' and 'Nikaal' which means 'Victory'. This name signifies the Goddess of Prosperity and Victory. It is believed that this name bestows upon the bearer immense strength, beauty, and protection. The name Sharunikaal carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity and Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sharunikaal usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharunikaal is a divine name that represents the power of the Goddess Lakshmi, the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity. It is believed that chanting this name helps one to overcome obstacles and achieve success in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Sharunikaal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity and Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharunikaal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
